title: Combined Cognitive–Motivational Modules Delivered via an LMS Increase Undergraduate Biology Grades
reason: Randomised trials meta-analysed: effect of assigned LMS-delivered cognitive/motivational modules (group membership) on course grades. 'Timely access' is a study-level moderator; no per-student platform measure enters any analysis.

extraction.design: 10 randomised experiments, internal meta-analysis with moderators
extraction.n_quote: Participants were 3,092 undergraduate introductory biology students tested in 10 studies at three universities over 4 years.
extraction.lms_indicators: none per student (module access timing coded per study/semester)
extraction.notes: Overall intervention effect g = .30 (treatment vs control); timely vs cramming access g = .39 vs .14 is a semester-level moderator. These are group-membership effects, not indicator-outcome relations.
